info.title: ◆ gcad Gravicode.CAD
info.description: gcad — the Gravicode.CAD command-line tool: convert between STEP/IGES/STL/OBJ/glTF/3MF/DXF/SVG/PDF, inspect and validate models, render PNG previews, make engineering drawings, rebuild parametric parts, slice for 3D printing and generate CAD from text with AI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil

commands.name: validate
commands.description:
Topology check (watertight, manifold, genus)
render   <file> <out.png> [--view iso|front|top|right] [--width 1600] [--height 1000] [--light] [--transparent]
drawing  <file> <out.pdf|svg> [--title "Part"]       Engineering drawing (4 views + title block)
build    <part.gcad.json> <out> [--set name=value]... Rebuild a parametric part
shape    <box|cylinder|sphere|cone|torus|tube|gear|nut> [numbers...] -o <out>
slice    <file> <out.gcode> [--layer 0.2] [--infill 0.2] [--perimeters 2]
generate "<prompt>" [-o dir] [--provider claude|azure|deepseek|hf|offline] [--key-file path] [--model id]
